questions.question_text: What is the primary purpose of the Educational Access Scheme (EAS)?
options: To reward students with high grades
To assist students who have experienced long-term educational challenges
To provide free laptops to all students
To guarantee admission for international students
questions.explanation: EAS helps students who faced disadvantages during their education gain admission to tertiary study.

questions.question_text: What is the main goal of the Schools Recommendation Scheme (SRS)?
options: To provide extra funding for high schools
To ensure students only get into university via their ATAR
To allow institutions to make early offers using criteria other than just the ATAR
To manage the release of ATAR results
questions.explanation: SRS allows universities to assess students for early offers using school recommendations and other factors beyond just the final ATAR result.

questions.question_text: What happens if you submit one Equity Scholarship application?
options: You are automatically accepted into every university
You will be considered for all available Equity Scholarships for which you are eligible
You will be charged a monthly membership fee
You are required to complete a manual application for each individual scholarship
questions.explanation: By submitting one Equity Scholarship application, you are automatically assessed for all the various Equity Scholarships for which you meet the eligibility criteria.

questions.question_text: When is the closing date for Schools Recommendation Scheme (SRS) applications for 2026 entry?
options: 11 September 2026
1 January 2027
1 June 2026
30 September 2026
questions.explanation: SRS applications close on 11 September, as per the UAC key dates.

questions.question_text: What is the primary purpose of the Schools Recommendation Scheme (SRS)?
options: To guarantee a scholarship for every applicant
To help institutions make early offers based on criteria other than just the ATAR
To replace the ATAR entirely for all university entries
To provide free accommodation for school leavers
questions.explanation: The SRS allows universities to consider factors such as school ratings and Year 11 results for early admission offers.

questions.question_text: What happens if you submit one Equity Scholarship application through UAC?
options: You are only considered for one specific scholarship
You are considered for all available Equity Scholarships for which you are eligible
You must apply separately to every university in the system
It is automatically rejected if you have an ATAR
questions.explanation: Submitting a single UAC application ensures you are evaluated for every eligible Equity Scholarship offered by participating institutions.

questions.question_text: What is the Educational Access Scheme (EAS) designed to do?
options: Award financial prizes for high grades
Help students who have experienced long-term educational challenges gain admission to tertiary study
Provide free textbooks to all first-year students
Guarantee admission to any course regardless of grades
questions.explanation: EAS assists students who have faced disadvantages during their education that have impacted their performance.

questions.question_text: What criteria might participating institutions use when assessing your SRS application?
options: Only your final ATAR
Only your birth date
School ratings of your aptitudes and Year 11 studies
Your parents' income exclusively
questions.explanation: SRS applications are assessed using multiple criteria, including school reports, school ratings, and other factors decided by the institution.
